intro.text: A lighteyed officer in Highprince Dalinar Kholin's army on the Shattered Plains.

items.text: Havar was with Dalinar at a firemoss den on the night Adolin was born, buying a round of drinks and sitting next to Bashin.

A good friend to both Dalinar and Adolin, Havar commanded the Kholin rearguard. At the Battle of the Tower, when Sadeas betrayed the Kholin army, he took a serious gut wound. He was rescued by Bridge Four but died soon after, and his loss fed Adolin's hatred for Sadeas.

personality.text: A bearded, good soldier who does his job well.
